title: An animal cell
caption: An animal cell has a nucleus, mitochondria, rough and smooth ER, a Golgi apparatus, lysosomes and a pair of centrioles, all inside a flexible plasma membrane. There is no cell wall and no chloroplast.
alt: An animal cell with labels for the plasma membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, nucleolus, mitochondrion, rough and smooth endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, lysosome, ribosomes and centrioles.
description: The nucleus, with its nucleolus, holds the DNA.
Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration and make ATP.
Rough ER (studded with ribosomes) makes proteins; smooth ER makes lipids.
The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts and dispatches proteins in vesicles.
Lysosomes digest worn-out parts and engulfed material.
The centrioles organise microtubules, including the spindle.
Only a plasma membrane bounds the cell: there is no wall.
